assets.prompt: Production PNG sprite atlas for a serious retro pixel-art desktop gardening game. Exactly square canvas, exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 equal square cells. True alpha TRANSPARENT background, no checkerboard painted, no grid, no text, no labels, no borders around cells. Each object is one complete isolated potted plant inside the CENTER 60 percent of its cell with generous 20 percent fully empty transparent margin on EVERY side. The entire pot, leaves and flowers must remain inside its own cell. Authentic low-resolution 32x32 or 48x48 game sprites scaled up with crisp square pixels and staircase edges. Strict monochrome 5-tone palette: near black, dark gray, medium gray, light gray, white. Flat pixel clusters, small controlled dither, clear silhouette. No anti-aliasing, no soft edges, no gradients, no 3D render, no toy styling. Absolutely NO faces, NO eyes, NO smiles, NO cartoon expressions, NO anthropomorphism. Same straight-on slightly top-visible perspective, consistent plain angular plant pots. Row 1 left to right: cell0 plain pot with bare dark soil; cell1 same pot with a single planted seed partly visible in soil; cell2 same pot with a tiny two-leaf sprout; cell3 same pot with a growing leafy stem. Row2: cell4 mature clover in plain pot; cell5 mature dandelion in plain pot; cell6 mature daisy in plain pot; cell7 small five-petal flowering plant in plain pot. Row3: cell8 tuft of grass in plain pot; cell9 a bunch of herbs in plain pot; cell10 broad basil plant in plain pot; cell11 marigold in plain pot. Row4: cell12 upright tulip in plain pot; cell13 rose on leafy stem in plain pot; cell14 rosemary in plain pot; cell15 lily flower in plain pot. All 16 images keep the pixel grid language even at small scale, with intact flowers and pots and very wide transparent gutters for CSS atlas slicing.

Production transparent PNG inventory icon atlas for a serious retro pixel-art desktop game. Exactly square canvas, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells. True alpha transparent background; no checkerboard, grid, text, labels or frames. Each ONE isolated icon fits inside the CENTER 60% of its cell with 20% fully transparent margin on all sides. Authentic 32x32 or 48x48 pixel-game icons scaled up, crisp square pixels, staircase edges, deliberate flat pixel clusters and tiny controlled dithering. Strict 5-tone grayscale only: near-black, dark gray, middle gray, light gray, white. Clear silhouettes readable at 24-48px. Absolutely no faces, no eyes, no smiles, no friendly characters, no toy-like roundness, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients, no 3D render, no soft shadows. Simple angular practical objects in one consistent inventory icon language. Row1 left to right: cell0 unlit lightbulb; cell1 lit lightbulb with a few short blocky light rays close to it; cell2 upright battery with a small lightning-bolt mark; cell3 electrical plug. Row2: cell4 closed rectangular storage chest with a plain latch, NO face; cell5 matching small storage chest with a clear upward arrow just above it for export; cell6 matching small storage chest with a clear downward arrow above it for import; cell7 simple gear wheel. Row3: cell8 magnifying glass; cell9 pouch with three coins; cell10 short ladder; cell11 pickaxe. Row4: cell12 seed packet with a tiny leaf symbol; cell13 angular watering can; cell14 empty plant pot with a small plus symbol beside it; cell15 a folded ribbon tab pointing inward, representing fold or return. Icons must stay centered and completely inside their own cells, including arrows and rays; make the arrows bold enough to read but never overlapping another cell.
